title: No More Diversity
description: Removes Mob Diversity added in Spring to Life.
body:
Uniform Textures for Spring to Life
This pack is a straightforward utility designed to disable the "**Diversity**" features added in the latest update.

Key Changes:

Entity Consistency: Removes randomized skin variations for animals and mobs.

Block Uniformity: Reverts block texture offsets and "biomic" variations to their base state.

Performance-Focused: Reduces the visual overhead of loading multiple texture variants in high-density areas.

_Note: This does not remove new content or items; it simply ensures they all use a single, unified texture._
